periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the bilateral black eye patches are oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt of approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches present as vertically elongated ovals with an approximate width-to-height ratio of 1:1.8.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct downward tapering, creating a teardrop morphology where the mass of the patch is concentrated in the superior half.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse dark band across the scapular region displays a shallow, broad U-shaped curve.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso profile at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The distance between the medial edges of the dark ear regions is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears are characterized by a continuous, smooth semicircular curvature without flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-red pigment staining is visible on the ventral and pelvic fur regions.
